notifications.name: 4in1 prefilled pod kit
notifications.danger: The product has an excessive volume of nicotine-containing liquid (8 ml). This could lead to the accidental consumption of a high dose of nicotine. Nicotine is acutely toxic and can endanger the user’s safety, notably if the product comes into contact with the skin or is ingested. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Tobacco Products Directive.

notifications.name: Stainless Steel Travel Electric Kettle
notifications.danger: The product is not adequately insulated between the heating element and the metal housing. The user could access live parts and receive an electric shock. Additionally the product lacks an automatic shut-off, the product could therefore overheat and deform, causing burns to the user. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Low Voltage Directive.

notifications.description: Foldable, black travel camping kettle, 100 ml – 600 W 304. Made of stainless steel, advertised as BPA-free – double-walled design with automatic temperature control and continuous boiling function.

notifications.danger: The product is supplied with a plug without fuse link and the adaptor provided with is not suitable. The user could therefore receive an electric shock and the product could cause a fire when charging. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Machinery Directive.
